# Agent Reach

Agent Reach is a capability layer for 10 internet platforms. It installs,
configures, and diagnoses upstream tools; it does not provide unified
`read`/`search` wrapper commands. Agents call the active upstream backend
directly after inspecting `agent-reach doctor --json`.

Supported channels: GitHub, Twitter/X, YouTube, Reddit, Bilibili (public
search API only), LinkedIn, V2EX, RSS, Exa Search, and Web.

Current CLI commands:

`setup`, `install`, `configure`, `doctor`, `uninstall`, `skill`,
`transcribe`, `check-update`, `watch`, and `version`.

Safety contracts:

- `doctor`, `install --dry-run`, and install plan mode are read-only.
- `doctor` is offline by default; the web/exa_search/bilibili/v2ex/linkedin
  probes that make outbound network requests report `status: "skipped"`
  unless `doctor --live` is passed.
- `install` requires `--yes` before it changes user state.
- System package managers, elevation, and downloaded setup scripts are never
  run automatically.
- Secrets use an interactive prompt, `--stdin`, or `--file`, never argv.
- Browser cookie auto-import (`configure --from-browser`) extracts only
  Twitter's `auth_token`/`ct0`.
- The Twitter probe never runs `twitter-cli` unless
  `TWITTER_AUTH_TOKEN`/`TWITTER_CT0` are configured, to avoid a macOS
  Keychain prompt.
- The packaged skill is fetch-only and treats fetched content as untrusted.

Documentation:

- Installation: https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/blob/main/docs/install.md
- Updates: https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/blob/main/docs/update.md
- English README: https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/blob/main/docs/README_en.md
- Agent skill: https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/blob/main/agent_reach/skill/SKILL_en.md
